d: Click to Food is a new food delivery platform launching in Dubai, connecting customers, restaurants and riders. We're a small, fast-moving team building something from the ground up, and we want partners who help us shape how restaurants grow on our platform.
q: Own a portfolio of key accounts: Manage Click to Food's top restaurants, chains and multi-brand groups, from go-live through long-term growth.
Build strong relationships: Be the main contact for owners, group managers and decision-makers, and earn their trust as a partner.
Drive growth with data: Review sales, ratings, menu performance and operational metrics, then turn them into clear actions that grow orders and profitability for both the partner and Click to Food.
Launch strong: Make sure key accounts go live smoothly, with complete menus, correct setup and a strong first few weeks.
Plan promotions and campaigns: Work with Marketing on offers, visibility and launch activities for your partners.
Solve problems fast: Work with Operations and Customer Support to fix issues around orders, delivery and partner experience.
Grow the account: Bring new brands and branches from your groups onto the platform, and negotiate renewals and commercial terms.
Order and sales growth across your portfolio
Operational quality (ratings, availability, cancellations)• New brands and branches added from existing groups
3–5 years of experience in account management, partnerships or commercial roles, ideally in food delivery, F&B or a marketplace business
Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with Excel and performance dashboards
Organized and reliable, with a team-player attitude
Adaptable and comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment
Knowledge of the UAE restaurant industry is a strong plus
Fluent English; Arabic is a strong advantage
r: This full-time, on-site Key Account Manager role is based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
Our Key Account Management team looks after Click to Food's most important restaurant partners: top-tier brands, multi-brand groups and high-volume chains.
We're more than a support line.
We act as growth partners, using data and industry know-how to help restaurants sell more and run better on our platform.
You'll report to the Operations Manager and work closely with Sales, Onboarding, Marketing and Operations.
x: Be part of a launch: Help shape how Click to Food works with restaurants from day one.
Real ownership: Manage the accounts that matter most to the business.
Grow with us: As the platform scales, so does your role.
